Neutrons detected at 26.443+/-0.002 m with a

by 5 mm lead, background points were determined with
black resonance technique using Cd, Au, Co, and Na
filters. The background was deduced from a fit of
the background points with a power function using
AGS. The neutron energy is derived from the measured
L=26.443 m and TOF in microseconds.
